description: Department of Census and  Statistics - Notify the National Consumer Price Index for the month of June, 2018
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for June 2018, published by the Department of Census and Statistics. The content is purely statistical information about economic indicators and does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or any of the specialized administrative categories (Types 4-9). It falls under general administrative announcements related to economic data reporting.
